answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: one identity, one bond. A Sybil farmer spinning up a thousand hollow shells must fund a thousand bonds, so the attack's cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so the stake becomes a jade seal of good conduct — cheap to keep, expensive to fake — and the umber ledger of locked value makes forgery unprofitable.
